Job Description:
Role: Dotmatics Consultant
Location:  Remote, USA

Notice: Immediate to 15 days


The individual will support projects for the R&D
division at Excelra for the Biopharma and Biotech customers. The individual
will act as a consultant/implementation lead and closely work with lab
scientists to gather requirements. He or she will have to work with scientists
and business/IT managers at Customers in conjunction with the delivery team to
configure the Dotmatics ELN.

 

Your responsibilities?

•                    
Leading Dotmatics implementation, designing
the data model, forms and templates as part of implementation

•                    
Provide Dotmatics training on configuration
to internal delivery team and the customer key users

•                    
Scientific business analysis skills to review
scientific business processes and systems. And create process flows using BPMN
tools like Visio and Lucid chart.

•                    
Gather requirements and document use cases to
present to various stakeholders

•                    
Demonstrate workflows to business users and
R&D IT stakeholders

•                    
Produce and deliver required configuration,
documents, and reports to customers

What we are expecting from
you:

•                    
3-5 years of Dotmatics configuration and
implementation experience from scratch, preferably has experience working on
latest version (7.1 onwards)

•                    
Strong interest in training on Dotmatics
configuration to other team members to make them project-ready

•                    
Strong SQL, Python and data model designing
experience

•                    
Ability to prioritise requirements, handle
escalations, guide the team and remove blockers

•                    
Experience with Scientific applications and
systems like LIMS and ELN is a plus

•                    
Experience with systems and instrument
integration and data migration is a plus

A successful Excelraites is:

•                    
Independent, Self-Motivated & Results
driven.

•                    
Willing & able to quickly acquire new
Technical Skills & Business Principles

•                    
A critical thinker who possesses logical
reasoning

•                    
Empathetic and always looking for creative
solutions to complex problems

•                    
Respect our core values – Trust,
Transparency, Teamwork, Integrity, and Commitment

What you bring to the table:

•                    
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree or equivalent in a
scientific or health care field.

•                    
Minimum three years as a Dotmatics
implementation consultant, preferably in the pharmaceutical /Life sciences
industry.

•                    
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process
and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

THE ROLE 

Shape the architecture
behind AI at Excelra. 

We’re hiring two AI
Architects to shape the architecture behind AI at Excelra and turn it into
production systems across the company. Reporting to the Head of AI, you’ll own
our reference architecture for AI in life sciences, drive AI enablement across
teams, and set the standards others build on. 

This is a hands-on-keyboard,
decision-making role for someone who builds, prototypes, and demonstrates — who
has deployed agentic, generative, and classical AI in production, and keeps
learning as the field moves. You know what survives contact with real users and
real audits. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Own the architecture, and
    make it easy to build on. 

  • Own and evolve our
    enterprise reference architecture for generative and agentic AI — across
    models, retrieval, orchestration, reasoning, and the governance that runs
    through all of it. 

  • Build and demonstrate,
    hands-on. Prototype in code, stand up working proofs and demos, and stay close
    to the models and tools — leading by showing, and learning continuously as the
    field moves. 

  • Build reusable frameworks,
    blueprints, and paved-road patterns that engineering and product teams
    adopt. 

  • Lead solutioning from
    proof-of-concept to production: scope experiments, prove them, and build the
    roadmap to scale. 

  • Stand up the shared AI
    platform and enablement — model serving, vector and graph retrieval, tool and
    agent orchestration, observability, and evaluation — and help teams build on it
    safely. 

  • Embed governance by design:
    traceability, human-in-the-loop, evaluation, and tenant isolation built into
    every architecture from the start. 

  • Own build-vs-buy decisions
    and set technical standards; run architecture reviews and mentor
    engineers. 

  • Translate technical
    trade-offs clearly for leadership, clients, and engineering. 

WHAT YOU’LL BRING 

  • Production-proven, end to
    end. 

  • Deeply hands-on — you still
    build. 8+ years in software / AI engineering, with production-proven delivery
    of agentic, generative, and classical ML/DL systems — not just POCs. 

  • Hands-on depth across the
    modern agentic stack: orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, Dapr Agents),
    protocols (MCP; familiarity with A2A), RAG and GraphRAG, vector and graph
    databases (e.g. Neo4j, pgvector), model serving (e.g. vLLM), and LLMOps (versioning,
    drift, cost, evaluation). 

  • Practical evaluation and
    guardrails experience — making model quality measurable and defensible. 

  • Command of the full span
    from classical ML/DL to generative to agentic, and the judgment to choose the
    simplest approach that works. 

  • Cloud and data-platform
    depth (AWS / Azure / Databricks) and familiarity with semantic layers and
    lakehouse architectures. 

  • End-to-end architecture
    ownership and the ability to set and evolve standards across an
    organisation. 

  • Excellent communication and
    stakeholder management, including with senior leadership, and a track record of
    mentoring. 

 

NICE TO HAVE 

  • Regulated-industry
    experience — life sciences, pharma, or healthcare — and compliance-aware AI
    architecture (GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ data integrity, EU AI Act /
    HIPAA awareness). 

  • Knowledge graphs, semantic
    layers, and ontologies as first-class design elements. 

  • Multi-tenant SaaS or
    customer-deployed system design. 

  • Public contributions —
    talks, writing, or open source — on generative / agentic AI architecture.

Research Data & Software Engineer (Contractor), Data Science & AI

Location: Long Island City, NY, USA

Hybrid

Term length: 12 months

Job Description:

In this role, you will develop and support digital solutions that enable scientists across Receptor Biology Discovery (RBD) to access, analyze, visualize, and interpret experimental data. You will work closely with scientists, assay developers, and data scientists to build software tools, automated workflows, and data infrastructure that support both day-to-day research activities and longer-term digitalization initiatives.

Your work will span scientific software development, data engineering, workflow automation, and scientific data management. You will help transform laboratory data into accessible, reliable, and reusable digital assets that accelerate scientific discovery and enable future AI-driven research approaches.

Your Key Responsibilities

•Develop and maintain software applications, dashboards, and visualization tools supporting scientific research.

•Build and support automated workflows for experimental data processing, analysis, and reporting.

•Develop data pipelines that connect laboratory systems, databases, and scientific applications.

•Collaborate with scientists to understand research needs and translate them into practical digital solutions.

•Improve scientific data quality, accessibility, and traceability through development of standardized workflows and tools.

•Support assay-specific analysis platforms and scientific data management systems.

•Participate in implementation of new digital capabilities and continuous improvement of existing platforms.

•Contribute to documentation, testing, and long-term sustainability of scientific software solutions.

You Bring

•BS + 4 years, MSc + 2 years, or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, or a related discipline.

•Experience developing software tools, applications, or automated workflows.

•Experience and proficiency in Python and JavaScript (Svelte/Sveltekit preferred).

•Experience working with scientific or technical datasets.

•Experience with SQL and relational databases.

•Experience with data visualization and dashboard development.

•Strong problem-solving skills and a desire to develop practical solutions for scientific challenges.

•Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

•Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred

•Experience supporting laboratory, research, or scientific environments.

•Experience developing web applications and interactive visualization tools.

•Experience with cloud-based or containerized applications.

•Experience with workflow automation and data pipeline development.

•Familiarity with machine learning, statistics, or scientific data analysis.

•Experience with version control systems such as Git.

Job Description: Clinical Pharmacology Systems Specialist

Location: USA (Hybrid, in office when needed)

Working hours:  US Eastern Time (EST)

Experience: 8+ years

Department : Clinical Pharmacology, working closely with IT, QA, InfoSec, Data Security and AI teams

About the Role

We need an experienced Clinical Pharmacology Systems Specialist to connect our Clinical Pharmacology (ClinPharm) team with IT. You’ll handle the technical side of ClinPharm tools and platforms: setting them up, deploying them and keeping them running. You’ll also make sure every system follows GxP rules and is fully validated and documented. You’ll also help us bring AI and LLM (large language model) tools into ClinPharm work in a safe and compliant way.

Key Responsibilities

  • IT Liaison and Communication
  • Be the main link between the Clinical Pharmacology team and IT for anything technical.
  • Lead communication with IT whenever ClinPharm tools are set up, upgraded or maintained.
  • Turn ClinPharm business needs into clear technical requirements, and explain technical limits back to scientists in simple terms.
  • Track open requests, issues and timelines, and keep everyone informed.
  • Tool and Platform Implementation
  • Help deploy, implement, and maintain ClinPharm platforms and tools (for example PK/PD modeling software, NCA tools, data platforms and scientific computing environments).
  • Take part in the full system lifecycle: requirements, vendor review, installation, setup, testing, go-live and support
  • Plan and support upgrades, patches, change requests and system retirement.
  • Make sure systems stay available and reliable, and handle incidents with IT.

GxP Compliance, Testing and Documentation

  • Plan and run GxP testing, including IQ, OQ and PQ, user acceptance testing (UAT) and regression testing.
  • Write and maintain validation documents, such as validation plans, user and functional requirements, risk assessments, test scripts, traceability matrices, summary reports and SOPs.
  • Build and improve GxP processes around each tool, covering change control, access management, audit trails, backup and restore, and periodic review.
  • Follow 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5 and data integrity (ALCOA+) principles.
  • Support internal audits and regulatory inspections that involve ClinPharm systems.

AI and LLM Tools

  •  Keep up with AI and LLM tools that could help clinical pharmacology work.
  •  Help evaluate, deploy and implement AI/LLM solutions with the AI, IT and InfoSec teams.
  • Help set up validation, governance and risk controls for AI tools used in a GxP setting.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration
  • Work closely with IT, QA, InfoSec, Data Security and AI teams.
  • Make sure new tools pass security reviews, data privacy checks and QA approval before go-live.
  • Coordinate with outside vendors on implementation, support and validation packages.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field
  • 8+ years of experience in pharma, biotech or a CRO, in a role covering IT systems, computer system validation (CSV/CSA) or scientific platform support.
  • Hands-on experience with GxP testing and validation documentation.
  • Proven experience deploying and maintaining enterprise or scientific software.
  • Good knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5 and data integrity rules.
  • Working knowledge of AI and LLM tools, including how they are deployed and the risks and controls they need.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical people and the other way round.
  • Available during US EST hours and able to come into the office when needed.

Nice to Have

  • A background in clinical pharmacology, or knowledge or experience of it (PK/PD, NCA, population PK, exposure-response).
  • Familiarity with ClinPharm tools such as Phoenix WinNonlin/NLME, NONMEM, R/RStudio, Monolix, Simcyp or similar.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS), Linux servers or high-performance computing environments
  • Exposure to CSA (Computer Software Assurance) approaches.
  •  Project management or ITIL certification.

Key Skills

GxP Validation · CSV/CSA · IQ/OQ/PQ · UAT · SOP Writing · Change Control · IT Liaison · System Deployment · AI/LLM Awareness · Cross-Team Communication · Vendor Management · Clinical Pharmacology (preferred)

Roles & Responsibilities

• Perform end-to-end validation testing activities for GxP applications in compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Develop, review, and execute validation deliverables including: 

o Validation Plans

o Test Strategy & Test Plans

o IQ/OQ/PQ protocols

o Test Scripts

o Traceability Matrix (RTM)

o Validation Summary Reports

• Conduct functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing for validated systems.

• Ensure applications comply with applicable GxP, CSV, and regulatory standards.

• Review business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documents to identify test scenarios.

• Execute manual validation test cases and document results with appropriate objective evidence.

• Perform defect management including identification, documentation, tracking, retesting, and closure.

• Support change control, impact assessments, risk assessments, and periodic review activities.

• Collaborate with business users, QA, development teams, and validation stakeholders.

• Maintain validation documentation according to SOPs and quality processes.

• Support audits and regulatory inspections by ensuring complete and compliant validation evidence.

Mandatory Skills

• Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Validation/Test Engineer.

• Hands-on experience working in a GxP-regulated environment is mandatory.

• Strong knowledge of: 

o Computer System Validation (CSV)

o GAMP 5 guidelines

o FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliance

o ALCOA+ principles

o Data Integrity requirements

• Experience in preparing and executing IQ, OQ, and PQ validation documentation.

• Strong understanding of SDLC and validation lifecycle processes.

• Experience with test management and defect tracking tools.

Technical Skills

• Test Management Tools: ALM/QC, Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent

• Documentation & Validation Tools: Veeva, TrackWise, ServiceNow, or similar (preferred)

• Database/SQL knowledge preferred

• Understanding of Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, clinical, laboratory, or life sciences domains.

• Experience validating applications in Life Sciences domain 

• Exposure to automated testing tools is an advantage.

• Knowledge of cloud-based validated systems preferred.

Soft Skills

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong attention to detail and documentation quality.

• Good communication skills with experience interacting with global stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently in a regulated environment.

Role Summary

  • The CMC Solutions Engineer will design and build the semantic and technical foundation for CMC data, with focus on two areas: developing the CMC ontology and knowledge model, and engineering automated, GxP-relevant stability data workflows.
  • Starting with stability monitoring data from CDMO-generated protocols and reports, this role will move CMC data away from siloed, manual processes (SharePoint, email, manual transcription into Excel) toward a structured, ontology-driven, auditable data layer that supports trending, alerting, regulatory reporting, and AI-assisted analysis.
  • The engineer will work closely with CMC subject matter experts (analytical development, stability, quality, and regulatory CMC), data architecture leads, and existing data catalog/data lake teams to deliver a proof of concept using CDMO data, then iterate toward a scalable, enterprise-reusable solution that extends beyond stability to manufacturing, specifications, reference standards, and document management.

Key Responsibilities

Ontology & Knowledge Modeling

• Design, build, and maintain the CMC ontology, beginning with the stability domain (studies, protocols, storage conditions, pull points, lots/batches, tests, methods, specifications, results, and impurities) and extending to manufacturing, reference standards, and document management

• Translate CMC business concepts and SME knowledge into well-formed ontologies, controlled vocabulary

• Align and explore applicability of established industry models where appropriate, such as the Allotrope Foundation Ontologies (AFO), Pistoia Alliance IDMP-O, and terminology consistent with ICH Q1 (stability) and ICH Q6 (specifications), rather than building from scratch

• Map extracted and source-system data to ontology classes and properties, and maintain semantic mappings between CDMO-specific terminology and internal standards

• Build and query knowledge graph representations of CMC data to enable cross-study, cross-lot, and cross-CDMO analysis

• Establish ontology governance: versioning, change control, stewardship roles, and documentation that supports use in a regulated environment

Stability Workflows & Data Engineering

• Map current-state and design future-state stability workflows end to end, from protocol setup and pull schedules through testing, results review, trending, out-of-trend (OOT) / out-of-specification (OOS) signaling, and reporting for regulatory submissions (e.g., CTD Module 3.2.P.8 / 3.2.S.7)

• Design and build automated pipelines to ingest stability protocols, reports, and results from CDMO-generated PDFs and other sources

• Develop parsing/extraction logic that handles varied PDF formats across CDMOs, including high-volume, structurally complex data

• Standardize extracted data into an ontology-aligned, auditable structure, and use historical Excel data and linked PDFs as a validation set to measure and improve extraction accuracy

• Enable downstream stability analytics, including trending, shelf-life estimation, and alerting (e.g., in JMP and Spotfire), in partnership with statisticians and stability scientists

• Extend existing data catalog/data lake capabilities to support CMC use cases, ensuring the solution is reusable across the broader enterprise

Governance, Collaboration & Delivery

• Build in governance, access control, traceability, data lineage, and audit trails consistent with GxP and data integrity (ALCOA+) expectations

• Lay the groundwork for natural-language querying and AI-assisted analysis of CMC data, using the ontology and knowledge graph to ground results

• Collaborate with CMC subject matter experts, data architecture leads, and IT to deliver an initial proof of concept within an agile, discovery-driven scope

• Contribute to build-vs-buy-vs-integrate evaluations for stability management, LIMS, and semantic platform tooling

• Document assumptions, data lineage, ontology design decisions, and workflow requirements to support the transition from bridge solution to long-term architecture

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Science, Life Sciences Informatics, Chemistry, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, knowledge engineering, or scientific informatics, including building data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, or document/data extraction solutions
